title: ISO 21940-11:2016+Amd 1:2022 — Mechanical vibration — Rotor balancing — Part 11: Procedures and tolerances for rotors with rigid behaviour
locator: ISO official catalogue: rigid-behaviour rotor balancing procedures and residual unbalance tolerances; 2026 systematic review entered 90.20 on 2026-04-15 and reached 90.60 close of review on 2026-09-03; the current page does not explicitly state the final outcome.
notes: Applies to rotors with rigid behaviour and explicitly excludes flexible-behaviour rotors, for which ISO 21940-12 is relevant. The standard does not provide a universal machine-tool spindle balance grade; rotor behaviour must be determined from the actual rotor/dynamic operating conditions. Do not treat the 2026 review as confirmed without an explicit ISO outcome.
